description: RectifHydPlus: Forty Year Hydropower Generation Reanalysis for Conterminous United States, Version 1.1. is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Sean Turner, Md Abu Bakar Siddik (Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States)). This dataset contains monthly hydropower net-generation totals for 590 plants (each 10 MW) across the conterminous United States (CONUS) from 1980 to 2019. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
